title: SyRuP: Enhancing System-Prompt Following via Reward-Guided Prediction in LLM Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2607.23991v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly controlled through system prompts that specify roles, formats, and safety requirements. However, models follow these prompts only implicitly through in-context learning, which can be insufficient for complex or compositional prompts. Existing approaches often require model tuning or response-level reranking, limiting their practicality for lightweight inference-time control. We introduce SyRuP, a decoding-time framework for improving system-prompt adherence while keeping the base LM frozen. SyRuP trains a cross-attention reward head from system-prompt-conditioned preference pairs, treating the system prompt as a separate memory to produce token-level adherence scores. At inference, SyRuP reranks the base LM's top-k candidates by combining base logits with both the learned reward signal and a contrastive signal that captures system-induced logit shifts. translated_title: SyRuP：通过奖励引导预测增强大语言模型解码中的系统提示遵循能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地通过指定角色、格式和安全要求的系统提示来进行控制。然而，模型仅通过上下文学习隐式地遵循这些提示，这对于复杂或组合性的提示来说可能是不够的。现有方法通常需要模型微调或响应级别的重排序，限制了它们在轻量级推理时控制方面的实用性。我们提出了SyRuP，这是一个解码时框架，能够在保持基础语言模型冻结的情况下提高系统提示遵循能力。SyRuP从以系统提示为条件的偏好对中训练一个交叉注意力奖励头，将系统提示视为独立的记忆，以产生token级别的遵循分数。在推理时，SyRuP通过将基础模型的logits与学习到的奖励信号以及捕获系统引起的logit偏移的对比信号相结合，对基础模型top-k候选进行重排序。在系统提示遵循（实验部分）……
tldr: 提出SyRuP解码时框架，通过训练交叉注意力奖励头并结合奖励信号与对比信号对候选token重排序，在不改动基础模型的情况下增强大语言模型对系统提示的遵循能力。
en_tdlr: SyRuP is a decoding-time framework that enhances system-prompt adherence in LLMs by training a cross-attention reward head and reranking top-k candidates with combined reward and contrastive signals, all while keeping the base model frozen.
